### ✨ Sniper Elite 4 Mod Menu (v1.2.4)
Pro Glass UI Mod Menu by **m0hammed** (`@m0hmm3d`) — supports both **Rootless (`arm64`)** and **RootHide (`arm64e`)**.

### 🔥 Mod Features
- **God Mode (Player Immunity)** — Player-only immunity in IsImmuneToRegularDamage & 0 bullet damage
- **Incoming Bullet Damage Scale** — Scales enemy bullet damage dealt to Karl (0% = No Damage, 100% = Normal)
- **Lock Resting Heart Rate (~55 BPM)** — Locks GetHeartRate/SetHeartRate to minimum & enables unlimited sprint
- **Unlimited Empty Lung & Focus** — Allows Empty Lung focus zoom at any heart rate
- **Infinite Magazine Ammo (No Reload)** — Hooks SE_ActiveItem_Firearm::UseUpAmmo so clip ammo never decreases
- **Infinite Reserve Ammo & Items** — Reloads, grenades, mines & medkits never decrease in SE_Inventory
- **No Bullet Spread (Laser Accuracy)** — Locks CurrentSpread to 0.0 and disables shot spread bloom
- **No Weapon Recoil** — Disables ProcessRecoilShot & UpdateRecoil camera kick
- **No Scope Wobble / Sway** — Eliminates sniper scope sway in SE_ActiveItem_Firearm::UpdateWobble
- **One-Hit Kill (Enemies & Vehicles)** — Forces player shots on non-players to fatal 1023.0f max damage
- **Custom Player Bullet Damage Multiplier** — Multiplies player bullet damage in ComputeDamage & AdjustDamageToNonPlayer
- **Bullet Damage Multiplier** — Multiplier applied to player shots against enemies & weak spots
- **Invisible to Enemies (Stealth Mode)** — Blocks AI line-of-sight & player sighting in SE_Knowledge_Vision
- **Silent Gunfire & Footsteps** — Prevents AI from registering player sound events in SE_Knowledge_Hearing
- **Bypass Apple ID Popup & Unlock Full Campaign + DLCs** — Blocks StoreKit SKReceiptRefreshRequest login alert & unlocks Complete Edition
- **Boost XP Gain** — Multiplies all XP earned in SE_StatTracker::ModifyAndAddXP
- **XP Gain Multiplier** — Multiplier for combat, stealth & mission XP rewards
- **Unlock All Weapons, Items & Skins** — Forces IsItemUnlocked, IsItemAvailable & IsSkinUnlocked = true

### 🔒 License & Activation
- **1-User Device Lock**: Each token locks automatically to the first device that activates it.
- **Trial & Full Keys**: Supports `2h` trial keys, `30d` plans, and Lifetime keys.
- **Telegram Support & Keys**: Contact **@m0hmm3d** on Telegram.
